title: Diabetes Support
ayurvedicView: Type 2 diabetes relates to Kapha imbalance. Lifestyle modifications alongside medical care are essential.
remedies: Soaked methi (fenugreek) seeds in the morning
Light walks after meals for blood sugar control
Work closely with healthcare provider for medication
Fibre-rich isabgol or ground alsi (flaxseed) with meals, taking medicines two hours apart
tips: Work closely with your healthcare team

icd11.title: Type 2 diabetes mellitus
icd11.note: The library entry supports type 2 diabetes alongside medical care.

seeDoctor: Blood sugar readings that stay above your target, or fall below 70 mg/dL
Great thirst, passing a lot of urine, confusion or drowsiness
A foot wound or sore that is not healing
